instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for Aftercare Threadboard: The goal is to track and coordinate follow-up actions created when a patient is cleared for discharge. Ward Coordinators record actions listed by the care team, Care Coordinators assign them to clinic teams and track whether they are open or done, Clinic Team Members add completion notes before marking actions done, and Patient Liaisons record patient contact details and responses when participation is required. The action-type list and available patient-contact channels remain undecided. The discharge summary stays in the existing records process.

instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Planning overview: The project is Aftercare Threadboard. Its objective is to track and coordinate follow-up actions created when a patient is cleared for discharge. The Ward Coordinator records follow-up actions listed by the care team. The Care Coordinator assigns each action to a clinic team and tracks whether it is open or done. The Clinic Team Member adds a completion note and marks an assigned action done only after the note has been added. The Patient Liaison records patient contact details and responses when an action requires patient participation. The project tracks follow-up actions but does not replace the existing discharge-summary process. The complete action-type list and the available patient-contact channels are not specified.

output.business_objective: Track and coordinate follow-up actions created when a patient is cleared for discharge.
